name: stbimage
description: A single compiled instantiation of stb_image and stb_image_write, shared by Ghoul and SGCT so that linking both into the same program does not produce a duplicate-symbol/ODR conflict. See https://github.com/sgct/stbimage for details.

This package exports two CMake targets: unofficial::stbimage::stbimage (declarations only) and unofficial::stbimage::stbimage-impl (the compiled implementation, linked once by whichever executable produces the final link). See usage for details.
